prompts.text: What small routine helps us enjoy a calm weekend together?
Tell me about a weekend outing we both enjoyed without planning ahead.
We have a free afternoon with no errands. Where would you like us to spend it?
I think unplanned afternoons sometimes make our best memories.
A quiet café together or a walk through the park?
I like how our conversations flow when we have nowhere to rush.
Which part of our usual weekend would you keep if our schedules changed?
Tell me about a shared activity that turned into a regular habit.
We both want a relaxed day but have different ideas. How should we choose?
What is a simple experience you would enjoy repeating with me?
